name: search_products
description: Search the catalogue by keyword and return matching products with their price and the total units available across variants. Results are product-level summaries: they do not include the per-variant SKUs, so a follow-up lookup is needed before an order can be placed. total_matches reports how many products matched in full, which can exceed the number returned.

query.description: Free-text keywords matched against product name, description and category.

category.description: Restrict results to one category. Must be one of the listed values; an unrecognised category is rejected rather than returning no matches.

max_price.description: Exclude products priced above this amount, in USD. Numeric.

in_stock_only.description: When true, exclude products with no units available in any variant.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return. Compare against total_matches to tell a short list from a truncated one.

error_returns.when: query is empty, category is not a recognised category, or max_price is not a number.
